model_meta.system_name: Top-entry trunnion ball valve maintenance system
model_meta.description: Inferred physical and maintenance-operation model of a top-entry trunnion rotary ball valve with retractable spring-loaded seats.

subsystems.description: Body with inlet/outlet passages, end connections, stepped seat recesses and threaded guide holes.
Removable cover secured to the body by studs for top-entry access.
Trunnion-mounted ball member with central bore and stem connection.
Soft insert seal, ball seat with flange bearing equally spaced engaging holes and cylindrical-surface guiding groove, seat retainer and compression springs in upstream recess.

interfaces.interface_type: guiding groove and guide assembly interaction

subsystems.description: Soft insert seal, ball seat with flange bearing equally spaced engaging holes and cylindrical-surface guiding groove, seat retainer and compression springs in downstream recess.

interfaces.interface_type: guiding groove and guide assembly interaction

subsystems.description: Relocatable guide screws with freely rotating bearings, parked normally and installed in threaded body holes for maintenance.
Removable rods engage seat-flange holes and transmit manual tangential force.

ports.name: Force delivered to seat flange holes

interfaces.interface_type: rod engagement with downstream seat flange holes

subsystems.description: External actor applying manual force and handling cover and ball member.

item_flows.name: Pipeline fluid
item_flows.notes: Passes through body passages and ball central bore when aligned.

item_flows.name: Manual tangential force
item_flows.notes: Applied to seat flange through straight rod.

item_flows.name: Seat axial movement
item_flows.notes: Guide and groove arrangement enables seat retraction against spring force.

requirements.statement: Seat retraction creates clearance between ball sealing surface and soft inserts sufficient to remove or assemble the ball member.
requirements.rationale: Claims 1 and 4 describe retraction against spring force and resulting mechanical clearance.

requirements.statement: A guide left in a threaded body hole interferes with the cover and prevents its installation.

steps.description: Remove the valve top cover by opening its studs.
Move guide assemblies from parking holes to threaded through-holes and tighten them.
Engage rods in seat-flange holes and turn in the marked direction repeatedly until seats retract against spring force and clearance is attained.
Remove or assemble the ball member through the top opening.
Turn rods in reverse to retract seats outward and restore sealing position or enable seat removal.

actions.name: Convert tangential force to upstream seat retraction

steps.description: Tangential force applied through the rod at the flange engaging holes causes axial force; the ball seat moves relative to the guide assembly and retracts into the recess against compression-spring force.

actions.name: Convert tangential force to downstream seat retraction

steps.description: Tangential force applied through the rod at the flange engaging holes causes axial force; the ball seat moves relative to the guide assembly and retracts into the recess against compression-spring force.
